title: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act — Statute profile
subject: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
summary: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act is a statute of United States enacted in 1996, in the area of healthcare privacy. Protects health insurance coverage and the privacy of health information. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 104-191.
key_points: Core effect: Protects health insurance coverage and the privacy of health information.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
